items.title: ‘I didn’t say which Diwali’: Boris Johnson on India-UK FTA deadline; hails scotch whisky tariff cut from 150% to 75%
items.summary: In a comical take on the India-UK Free Trade Agreement timeline, Boris Johnson revealed his contentment with the trade deal's finalization. He emphasized notable tariff cuts on Scotch whisky as a highlight. Following Brexit, the trade relationship has flourished, and Johnson envisions even greater economic collaboration across multiple sectors in the future.
